summary: the same requirement or element name is defined more than once
help: Give each requirement and element a distinct name.
rationale: Relationships and styling target the name, so a duplicate makes those targets ambiguous.

summary: the same requirement id value is used more than once
help: Give each requirement a unique id value.
rationale: A requirement id should identify exactly one requirement, and a duplicate defeats that purpose.

summary: a relationship endpoint names an undefined requirement or element
help: Define the named requirement or element, or fix the spelling.
rationale: Mermaid drops the relationship silently, so the diagram shows fewer links than the source declares.
